body:
# 🌿 MineboxTools - A set of tools for a better experience on Minebox

---

## 📦 Requirements

- Minecraft: 26.1
- Fabric Loader: >= 0.16.14

## 🎮 Features

### ⚙️ Configuration & Menu

- Open the mod menu with /mbt
- Customize all display options directly from the in-game menu
- Toggle features, configure HUD layout, search insects/shops, switch language — all in one screen

### 🛠️ Item System

- Item Stats Tooltip: Displays min/max stat ranges next to each stat in the tooltip
- Item Score: Calculates a global score (0–100%) for each item based on its rolling stats
- Item Highlight: Golden border on inventory slots whose item score exceeds a configurable threshold
- Durability Display: Custom durability bars for special items (hammers, watering cans, vein miners, etc.)
- Dual Durability HUD: Shows durability for both main-hand and off-hand items
- Haversack Capacity: Displays current/max item count for haversack containers
- Harvest Info: Tooltip shows spawn zones, spawn conditions, and boost conditions for harvestable items

### 🌍 World & Availability Icons
Contextual icons appear on the HUD depending on current conditions:

- Weather: Rain and thunder icons
- Time of Day: Morning, afternoon, evening, night slots
- Insects (28 configurable): Ant, Firefly, Scorpion, Spider, Mantis, Purple Emperor (full/new moon), Snail (bad weather), and many more
- Shops (6 configurable): Coffee Shop, Bakery, Cocktail Bar, Painting Shop, Italian Restaurant, Herb Shop (full moon only)
- Icon customization:
  - Size: Small / Normal / Large
  - Orientation: Horizontal / Vertical
  - Growth direction: Auto / Left / Right / Up / Down
  
### 👤 Player Stats HUD

- Displays combined player stats (armor + held item bonuses) directly on the HUD
- Three display modes: Simple (symbol + value), Advanced (full name + value), Off

### 🔍 Player Lookup Commands

- /mbtlookup <username> — Fetches a player's full profile: playtime, guild, skills, relics, museum count, quests
- /mbtguild <guild_name> — Displays guild info: level, member list, online status, owner
- /mbtlevel <username> <skill> <level> — Calculates XP needed to reach a target skill level

### 🌐 Localization
Full translation available in English and French
Language can be switched in-game from the mod menu
